authority: User instruction 2026-09-28 (/cess): typed NuExtract schema must be ignored; readings are strings; the driving LLM interprets units and times.
classification: approved sketch change (S4.8: string readings, controller judgment, read budget)
input_and_actual: Live facade booking run 2026-09-28: cua_read with duration typed duration_minutes over 12 slots. NuExtract returned 'half-hour' for the Telehealth slot on all five readings; the typed normalizer raised, the record became unknown, choose deferred with a re-read hint, the agent re-read four times, then a Jev->Qwen cascade chose. 144 s, 42 turns, $1.85; native tools 41 s, 13 turns.
corrected_behavior: The reading returns 'half-hour' as a known string; the LLM judges eligibility over the strings; a judged or filter-unique singleton binds directly; a third reading of the same records is refused with the extracted strings. A verdict that skips an unknown record defers until the controller names it in accept_unknown (S4.2 section 4 preserved).
tempting_wrong_repair: Teach the duration normalizer 'half-hour' and 'thirty minutes'; keep the re-read hint; leave readings unbounded; send the singleton to the chooser anyway.; authorize a verdict that skips unknown records and merely trace them; accept any or wildcard accept_unknown IDs.
adjacent_holes: Chooser accuracy on multi-candidate judged scopes is unmeasured. Live confirmation of the accept_unknown path is pending (unknowns were absent in the live run).

The whole-window fingerprint refused: 'UI changed since selection'. The same false refusal occurred in the 2026-09-28 A1 run.
corrected_behavior: Compare the content scope holding the offered actions (the AXWebArea for a page, else the window) together with the browser address field; refuse on any change inside it or a URL change; ignore other browser chrome.

authority: Proposed; pending user approval. Motivated by 15 live runs (2026-09) and the sketch design that the dispatcher, not the driving LLM, runs the evidence chain (S4.1-S4.2, S4.6, S4.8; S4.2 section 7 for recovery).
classification: architecture regression: LLM-mediated hops (facade projection of S4.1-S4.2), not a policy change
input_and_actual: Across 15 live runs the facade tools were 13% of agent wall time (138 s of 1,099 s); the other 87% was the driving LLM (about 2.9 s per turn, 374 turns). The facade exposed read, choose, act, verify and finish as separate MCP tools, so the LLM mediated every hop: a clean booking took 9 LLM-visible calls where native tools take about 5. Nothing in the repo noticed the drift.
corrected_behavior: cua_do runs the chain server-side in one call (observe, read, same-record filter, chooser only if several remain, bind, act with S4.8 revalidation, independent verify) and recovers in bounded deterministic code: stale UI or shifted indices reobserve and re-run the whole pipeline with a NEW selection (at most 2 passes, never reusing a stale selection or its tokens, a different fresh pick is a real change and defers); a pre-click Driver/provider failure is retried once after a short backoff (never a click); an unknown field is re-read once; verification escalates AX, then Perception (never satisfying on digits), then the screenshot model; a confirm dialog is confirmed only after its displayed identity matches the selected record. It returns deferred/failed to the LLM only for (A) a click that may have been delivered but could not be verified, (B) ambiguity (several eligible records, an unknown competitor without accept_unknown, records_ambiguous) and (C) a real content change inside the bound scope that alters which record matches. A clean run is 1 LLM-visible call; specialists still do all reading, matching and choosing. The primitives remain as Advanced escape hatches with unchanged behavior. CALL_BUDGET.json, scripts/check_call_budget.py, a skill lint and the live scorer keep it that way.
tempting_wrong_repair: A lean path that drops specialist offloading (the LLM reads and picks itself); speeding up the specialists (they are 13% of the time); merging tools without a budget so the count creeps back; making cua_do call the chooser for grounded singletons or read twice; letting recovery rebind the consumed selection or loop until stable; retrying a click or anything after a click may have been delivered; treating delivery or an unknown verification as success; dumping the full observation into the response.
regression: facade/test_do.py (booking one read/zero chooser/one click, two-eligible one chooser call, unknown competitor defers, incomplete-scope gate, discovery ambiguity, window resolution, answer-leak before any call, recovery rows 1-6 and cases A/B/C, click never retried, pass cap, budget, verification escalation, confirm dialog identity, response size, regions); facade/check_protocol.py (cua_do first, one end-to-end call); facade/test_budget.py and facade/call_budget.py (CALL_BUDGET.json provenance, real server tools through a counting harness, tool-surface and Advanced-docstring invariants, skill default-workflow lint, and mutation checks that the guards fail on the wrong patches); scripts/check_call_budget.py; experiments/facade-vs-native/test_score.py (llm_visible_calls counter and --fail-over-budget); .github/workflows/offline-gates.yml.
adjacent_holes: Live A/B against the native arm is pending; the budgets are fake-fixture ceilings, not measured live accuracy. Regions mode inside cua_do relies on Perception being healthy and on quoted-label corroboration. A dialog after a non-record click cannot be identity-checked and defers. Post-click verification observes again (one extra Driver observation) rather than reusing the act revalidation snapshot. The sketch text is unchanged; proposed wording for S4.2 section 7 (the recovery table) is in the branch report.
